# [TASK] Frontend: Recommendations view/section

## Task
Build the Recommendations view/section rendering ranked, explained results.

## Parent Story
Parent: #196

## Scope
Presentation only — consumes Task #2's hook.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] New view or homepage section, following existing `MovieList`/`Movie` component conventions and styling
- [ ] Each result shows ai-service's explanation text, not just a bare movie card (per #196 AC4)
- [ ] Empty state (no history) and error state each render distinct, clear UI — no blank screen either way
- [ ] Loading state matches the existing skeleton/spinner convention used elsewhere in the app
